title: Adrián Ochoa
vital_facts: Married Nancy Villareal, Mexico City Mexico Temple; Five children.
Bachelors in Communications, Universidad Regiomontana; Master's in business and marketing, Monterrey Technical College, Mexico.
Owns an advertising and marketing company; Director of Public Affairs, Mexico North Area.
Branch President, Stake High Councilor, Stake President, Area Seventy.
President of the Honduras San Pedro Belieze Mission.
Second Quorum of the Seventy, 2013 - present.
accuracy_caveat: Community-compiled biographies from gapages.com (offline since 2023). Recovered from the Wayback Machine. Cross-reference with official Church sources.
